newsitem.title: JAPAN: ANA honorary chairman to quit over management row.
newsitem.headline: ANA honorary chairman to quit over management row.

text.p: All Nippon Airways (ANA) said on Thursday its honorary chairman Tokuji Wakasa will resign from his post as director of the company.

The spokesman declined to confirm the reason for his resignation, but Japanese media reports said it was to take responsibility for an internal management struggle which prompted the resignation of president Seiji Fukatsu last week.

Wakasa, an 82-year-old former vice transport minister who joined Japan's second-largest airline in 1969, has been under fire since ANA announced Fukatsu's intention to resign after the company's board of directors meeting, set for late June.

Japanese media reports say Fukatsu announced his abrupt decision to step down because of disagreements with Wakasa over company management and personnel issues, including a plan to restructure the airline.
